tickets.title: Prepare Moonbadger Arts Center share-transfer instructions
tickets.text: Prepare approximately $25,000 share-transfer instructions for Sela Mossbutton’s appreciated Velvet Acorn Growth Fund shares in her joint-taxable account with Jonah Mossbutton. Use verified brokerage-delivery details for Moonbadger Arts Center’s youth-workshop fund. Sela prefers shares over cash checks if manageable.
tickets.evidence: asked for agreed 2026-01-23 approximately-$25,000 share-transfer instructions to Moonbadger using verified brokerage-delivery details.
